headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录287篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究195篇, 开源项目52篇, 模型发布40篇。热门标签：Agent（79篇）。其中11%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ Nutlope /hallmark：Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

▸ nightly-labs /openbot：A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedica

▸ obra /superpowers：An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.

▸ pbakaus /impeccable：The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.

▸ makecindy /cindy：Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
